name: Itenomiya Sataly
source:
The fun-loving, freedom-loving Sagittarius Prince.

He’s cheery and talkative and a born entertainer. He loves traveling and is always on the move, going from one place to another. He has the ability to make friends everywhere he goes. He’s an optimist, but he doesn’t plan ahead and does not think about things that don’t interest him. He also causes trouble by impulsively saying everything on his mind.
